engine: Godot 4.7.2; Vulkan-only clients; console-only Linux server; Jolt Physics

original_st_rebuild.spawn_adjustment: Lower east spawn moved 0.5 m off a triangulation seam; original flag objectives retained.

launcher_integration: Passed: identity, Q3 colours/clan, avatar acknowledgement, favourites queries, preload, import, BSP/VRM submission, rejection and cancellation.
updater: Passed transactional install/recovery/rollback, conflict and path validation, HTTP cancellation, SHA verification and outdated-client gating.
limitations: No new native Windows or physical Quest/OpenXR/haptics hardware playtest.
Expansion geometry/navigation and short bot tests do not certify competitive balance or maximum-player performance.
ST bot vehicle support is limited to Scout/Shrike pilots; coordinated transport/passenger AI is not implemented.
publication_integrity: Final archive checksums and release commit are recorded in the separately published BUILD-MANIFEST.json and SHA256SUMS; prepare_release.py verifies final archive integrity and payload exclusions before publication.
